mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_cancellation (application_id, student_id, return_time, status, comment) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{studentId}, #{returnTime}, #{status}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS student_name FROM leave_cancellation c JOIN `user` u ON c.student_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS student_name FROM leave_cancellation c JOIN `user` u ON c.student_id = u.id WHERE c.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS student_name FROM leave_cancellation c JOIN `user` u ON c.student_id = u.id WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
